<?php
final class FooTest extends \PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase
{
    public function testA()
    {
        $this->assertIsFloat($a);
        $this->assertNotNull($a, 'msg');
        $this->assertIsNotIterable($a);
        $this->assertInternalType($type, $a);
        $this->assertInternalType('foo', $a);
        $this->assertInternalType('int');
        $this->assertInternalType;
        new class {
            public function a() { $this->assertInternalType('int', $a); }
        };
        $this->assertIsInt($a);
    }
}
